name: CodifyCore Courier Connector
author: codifycore

sections.description:
CodifyCore Courier Connector is a free courier-dispatch addon for WooCommerce and FluentCart.

Learn more on the CodifyCore Courier Connector plugin page or follow the CodifyCore Courier Connector documentation for setup and usage instructions.

Version 1.0.0 intentionally has a small scope:

  • Select one ecommerce platform: WooCommerce, FluentCart, or Disabled.
  • Select one courier: SteadFast, ShipStation, or Disabled.
  • Configure courier credentials without displaying saved secrets again.
  • Review recent orders on a dedicated CodifyCore > CodifyCore Courier Connector > Orders screen.
  • Manually send an order to the selected courier.
  • Refresh the saved remote order status.
  • Open CodifyCore Courier Connector from supported host order screens.

The plugin does not include licensing, paid feature gates, telemetry, automatic order dispatch, background synchronization, or a private update system.

Order data and COD

CodifyCore Courier Connector reads orders only from the selected ecommerce platform. Paid orders are sent with a zero COD amount. Unpaid orders are sent with the order total as the COD amount.

The plugin stores the remote courier order ID, selected courier, status, dispatch time, and last error with the ecommerce order. This metadata is retained if CodifyCore Courier Connector is uninstalled so the store keeps its fulfillment audit trail.

External services

CodifyCore Courier Connector connects directly to the courier selected by the site administrator. No order data is sent to CodifyCore.

Remote calls occur only when an authorized user explicitly tests a connection, sends an order, or refreshes its status. Dispatch requests can include the order number, recipient name, email address, phone number, billing and shipping addresses, purchased items, payment method, totals, and an optional customer note. Connection tests send the saved API credentials, while status requests send the remote courier order identifier and saved credentials.

SteadFast Courier

  • Service: https://steadfast.com.bd/
  • Terms: https://steadfast.com.bd/terms-and-condition
  • Privacy: https://steadfast.com.bd/privacy
  • API endpoint contacted: https://portal.packzy.com/api/v1/
  • A SteadFast merchant account and API credentials are required.

ShipStation

  • Service: https://www.shipstation.com/
  • Terms: https://www.shipstation.com/terms-of-service/
  • Privacy: https://www.shipstation.com/privacy-policy/
  • API documentation: https://docs.shipstation.com/apis/shipstation-v1/docs/start-here/requirements
  • API endpoint contacted: https://ssapi.shipstation.com/
  • Version 1.0.0 uses ShipStation API V1, which ShipStation identifies as legacy and limits to eligible account plans. V1 API credentials are required. The optional store ID assigns orders to a specific ShipStation store.

Privacy

CodifyCore Courier Connector adds suggested text to WordPress Settings > Privacy for disclosure of the selected courier service. Site owners remain responsible for reviewing their courier agreement and publishing an accurate privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate CodifyCore Courier Connector.
  2. Install and activate either WooCommerce or FluentCart.
  3. Go to CodifyCore > CodifyCore Courier Connector > Settings.
  4. Select exactly one ecommerce platform and one courier.
  5. Enter credentials for the selected courier and save.
  6. Use Test Selected Courier to verify the connection.
  7. Open the Orders tab to dispatch or refresh an order.

Selecting Disabled for either integration stops CodifyCore Courier Connector from operating orders. The plugin never activates both platforms or both couriers at once because each setting is a single-choice selector.
sections.faq:
Can I enable WooCommerce and FluentCart together?

No. CodifyCore Courier Connector stores one active platform. You can switch platforms later without deleting courier metadata already attached to orders.

Can I enable SteadFast and ShipStation together?

No. CodifyCore Courier Connector stores one active courier. This prevents an order action from being routed ambiguously.

Does CodifyCore Courier Connector send orders automatically?

No. Version 1.0.0 requires an authorized user to explicitly send each order.

Does the plugin require a CodifyCore license?

No. Version 1.0.0 is completely free and contains no license or Pro feature checks.

Why is the ShipStation store ID optional?

CodifyCore Courier Connector uses ShipStation’s Create/Update Order API. Enter a store ID to assign created orders to that ShipStation store, or leave it empty to use the account default.

What happens to saved credentials on uninstall?

CodifyCore Courier Connector removes its settings option, including courier credentials. Courier status metadata remains with ecommerce orders as a fulfillment audit trail.

Where can I find setup instructions?

See the CodifyCore Courier Connector documentation for installation, configuration, and usage guidance.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial free release.
  • Added exclusive WooCommerce and FluentCart platform selection.
  • Added exclusive SteadFast and ShipStation courier selection.
  • Added manual order dispatch, remote status refresh, credential tests, privacy disclosure, and a dedicated operations screen.

short_description: Send FluentCart or WooCommerce orders to SteadFast or ShipStation from one focused courier operations screen.
